integrity: The all-dimension result has a direct Fourier-block proof; finite numerical tests are supplementary. This is a scientific claim, not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact bands apply to the explicitly oriented, counting-measure triangulated cyclic annulus and positive global weights; arithmetic coincidences are at equal weights, and no exhaustive all-eigenvalue resonance list is asserted. Full text of a relevant 2023 Hodge spectral paper was unavailable; its abstract was inspected. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Arithmetic gradient–curl resonances and sharp damping on triangulated cyclic annuli
